Verified live end-to-end against a real JasonCross+WorkerUniform .duf scene (user built it in Daz Studio GUI). Two real findings: (1) FIXED: daz_export.py never resolved --scene/--out to absolute paths before handing them to Daz Studio, which runs with its own working directory -- a relative path (as shown in docs/outfit-onboarding-workflow.md's own example) could silently misplace or fail to find the .dbz even on success. Fixed in export_scene() and covered by a new regression test in tests/test_daz_export.py. (2) NOT FIXED, filed as scarecrow-n4c (P1 bug): the real headless invocation reproducibly hangs -- Daz Studio runs an initial Iray preview render then goes idle indefinitely before ever executing the injected export script, and subprocess.run's timeout does not fire, requiring a manual process kill both times it was reproduced. Also confirmed: if Daz Studio is already running interactively, -noPrompt silently forwards to the existing GUI instance via IPC instead of launching an independent headless process (ignoring -noPrompt/-noSplash/-script) -- Daz Studio must be fully closed first. Did not reach the author_outfit_variant.py import-verification step since the .dbz was never produced; that remains open pending scarecrow-n4c.

Verified end-to-end against Abby Morgan (Genesis 9 + outfit + hair). Found and fixed 3 real bugs surfaced by this first real run: (1) DBZ export embeds empty filepath if DAZ scene was never saved as .duf, causing silent zero-content import -- docs updated to make Save As non-optional and onboard_character.py now raises a clear error instead of silently importing nothing; (2) Diffeomorphic's DBZFILE fit mode requires the .dbz to sit next to its source .duf with matching basename, not wherever --dbz-out points -- onboard_character.py now stages this automatically; (3) import_daz_artifact.py's collection-detection only scanned direct children of scene root, missing content DAZ's importer nests under whatever collection is active at import time -- fixed to scan the actual active collection. Registry gained a correct AbbyMorgan CharacterRecord, master .blend loads with correctly named/nested collection (23 objects, 5 armatures), and a headless smoke-test render via blender/worker.py succeeded. Also satisfies Phase 3's need for a real second character.
